_meanings:
.²1 Depending on or from, hanging from.
.²2 Support, prop, stay; {#etadAlambanaM SrezWametadAlambanaM param#} <ls>Kaṭh. 2. 17</ls>.
 <ls>Ki. 2. 13</ls>; {#jAtasya nadItIre tasyApi tfRasya janmasAPalyam .#}
 {#yatsalilamajjanAkulajanahastAvalambanaM Bavati ..#} <ls>Pt. 1. 28</ls>; sustaining,
 supporting; <ls>Me. 4</ls>.
.²3 Receptacle, abode; <ls>U. 6. 10</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>).
.²4 Reason, cause.
.²5 Base.
.²6 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) That on which a {#rasa#} or sentiment, as it were, hangs,
 person or thing with reference to which a sentiment arises, the natural
 and necessary connection of sentiment with the cause which excites it.
 The causes ({#viBAva#}) giving rise to a {%Rasa%} are classified as
 two:-- {#Alambana#} and {#uddIpana#}; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} in the Bībhatsa sentiment
 stinking flesh <ab>&c.</ab> is the {#Alambana#} of the {%Rasa%}, and the attendant
 circumstances which enhance the feeling of loathing (the worms <ab>&c.</ab> in
 the flesh) are its {#uddIpanAni#} (exciters); for the other {%Rasas%} see <ls>S. D. 210-238</ls>.
.²8 The mental exercise practised by the Yogin in endeavouring to bring
 before his thoughts the gross form of the Eternal.
.²9 Silent repetition of a prayer.
.²10 (With Buddhists) The five attributes of things corresponding to five
 senses, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} {#rUpa, rasa, ganDa, sparSa#} and {#Sabda#}.
.²11 {%Dharma%} or law corresponding to {%manas%}.
